integrity: The acceptance kernel and all distance statements are proved analytically for arbitrary \(n\). The transfer-matrix law is derived from the exact domain-wall generating function. The bundled finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem uses the source's ideal implicit-check observables and an effective premeasurement Pauli-\(X\) plus classical-readout-flip model. It does not model dephasing, leakage, coherent faults, circuit-internal check-gadget faults, target-register propagation, or correlated noise. The stochastic formulas assume independent faults; the deterministic acceptance kernel does not.
title: Joint-fault distance of implicit \(\operatorname{collapse}(n)\) checks
